Method of Attack: Allows a remote attacker with access to the DLNA server (default port 8200) to create arbitrary file data on any (non-existing) location, without any prior knowledge or credentials.
Capable to elevate that vulnerability to remote code execution on the remote NAS as well.
Impacted Systems: Other QNAP models and firmware versions

Method of Attack: Allows a remote attacker with access to the webserver (default port 8080) to execute arbitrary shell commands, without prior knowledge of the web credentials.
Triggers remote code execution indirectly (i.e., triggers some behavior in other processes).
Impacted Systems: Other QNAP models and firmware versions
